policy: Approved page structure and field placement are immutable. Do not change protected screen HTML, screen order, application chrome, or field/control order unless the user explicitly authorizes a layout change. Authorized SEC layout: Scenario 1 Join/Transit keeps the inline IATA-prefix + SEC-number field. Scenario 2 Final Call SEC page is intentionally removed for both Join and Transit. Authorized progress update: all progress text uses 20px/700; Scenario 1/2 progress uses “Flow - N/N - Passenger Type” after Passenger Type selection; before selection it uses “Flow - N/N”. Authorized responsive adjustment: keyboard-open mode may change Safe Area spacing and vertical workspace distribution, while protected screen/chrome markup and field/control order remain immutable. Authorized message-preview update: Message Preview is read-only on all message paths; Edit and Copy Text controls are removed. Authorized final visual tuning: preview language-order labels use 18px/700; progress counts use a lighter gray-green while retaining 20px/700. Scenario 3 step 2/4 Bag Tag 1 is restored to its prior stacked layout. Scenario 3 step 4/4 Confirm details places “無人領取的行李” immediately left of the Bag Tag 1 number at 18px/700. Confirm-details SEC displays IATA and SEC with visual spacing, and “Proceed to Gate” is renamed “Go to Gate”. These authorized regions are locked again. Authorized Passenger Type hierarchy: in Scenario 1 and Scenario 2, Join Pax & Message is the large primary option; Transit Pax & Message and Call Directly are smaller secondary options beneath it. Authorized progress compaction: numeric progress is displayed without spaces around the slash (for example 1/4). These authorized regions are locked again. Authorized Scenario 4 layout change: Flight Type is step 1/6 and uses the Passenger Type visual hierarchy; Tight Connection is the large primary choice, with Delayed and To be updated as the two smaller choices below. Authorized Scenario 4 follow-up: Flight Type remains step 1/6 but now behaves exactly like a Passenger Type choice page: its heading uses the default Passenger Type placement and it has no footer/Next. The delayed-time control is moved from Flight Type to Disrupted flight step 2/6, where it appears only for Delayed. Tight Connection and To be updated do not show that control. These authorized regions are locked again. Authorized label change (user-approved 2026-09-23): Scenario 4 Flight Type third option is renamed from “To be updated” to “Suspended”; s-dstatus is locked again with this label. Authorized layout change (user-approved 2026-09-23): Scenario 4 step 2/6 title is the single line “Flight from TPE” and the TPE chip is removed; s-dflight is locked again with this structure. Authorized release-label rename: visible release identity changed from r41 to R1; no other protected s-phone structure changed.
authorization_rule: A verifier failure must not be fixed by regenerating hashes unless the user explicitly approves the specific layout change.
normalization: Exact UTF-8 HTML substrings are SHA-256 hashed. Any protected markup change requires explicit approval.
